text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: LEVEL=SEV2 billing-metering anomaly detected — shadow tally diverging from ledger by ~15% for the last 2 hours. Auto-alert: overage flags firing for multiple tenants.

jia_oncall: Acknowledged. Paging billing and SRE. @maria_billing @alex_sre please triage. Any immediate customer-facing alerts? :eyes:

maria_billing: On it. I'm seeing delayed usage batch ingestion from emitter cluster-em-7 — batches are queuing, ingestion worker lag ~2h. Some downstream delta aggregation jobs applied partial counts, so we have double-path mismatch (live path vs backfilled path).

alex_sre: Looking at emit logs. I see retries from proxy with 503s around 02:14-02:30 UTC. Grep: `zcat /var/log/emitter/*.gz | grep "503" | wc -l` -> ~12k hits. KV cache window also shows stale sequence numbers.

jia_oncall: Customer impact likely: transient undercount then late backfill causing overage flags. Recommend: 1) Pause automated overage emails, 2) Stop charge reconciliation until we reconcile counts, 3) Start emergency backfill job once ingestion stabilizes. Agree?

maria_billing: Agree. Pausing overage-notify job now. `svc billing-notify scale to 0` (done). Marking affected accounts with tag `billing_investigation` to prevent auto-billing.

eric_prod: Noted. I'll disable the overage webhook to Support so CS doesn't get pages. `curl -X POST https://internal-api/feature-toggle -d '{"overage_webhook":false}'` -> 200 OK.

alex_sre: Root cause hypothesis: proxy retry surge caused emitter spool to fall behind; emitter replays create temporary duplicate partial-window aggregates consumed by the delta-agg job which ran before full replay completed. Mitigation plan: throttle emit retries, restart emitter workers, and run a bounded backfill with dedupe. Steps:
```
# restart workers
kubectl rollout restart deployment/emitter-workers -n prod
# kick off dedupe-backfill
python tools/backfill_dedupe.py --start 2026-03-15T00:00Z --end 2026-03-15T03:00Z --max-parallel=8
```

jia_oncall: Good. Alex, can you take ownership of the backfill? Maria, you own billing reconciliation and customer comms. I'll stay on for the handoff for the next 30m then switch to night oncall.

alex_sre: Taking the backfill. Will post progress updates and ETA. Current ETA for safe run ~45 minutes after restart.

maria_billing: Drafting customer note for affected customers: short explanation + assurance: we will reconcile and reverse any erroneous overage charges. Ping @eric_prod for legal/CS blur if needed.

eric_prod: Ack. We'll hold billing runs for the impacted window. CS playbook: send proactive message once we have final reconciled counts.

incident-bot: Action created: INC-489001 (billing-metering-shadow-drift). Assigned: alex_sre (backfill), maria_billing (recon + comms), jia_oncall (handoff). Priority SEV2.

jia_oncall: Handoff: I'm stepping off active control in 30m. Primary contact will be @maria_billing for customer impact and @alex_sre for technical remediation. If new regressions appear escalate to SEV1.

alex_sre: Restart done, backfill started. Progress: 10% completed, dedupe pass in progress, no further 503s observed in proxy since restart.

maria_billing: Oversee tags: added `billing_investigation` to 142 accounts, suppressed billing emails for those tenants. Preparing internal incident summary for CS.

eric_prod: Confirmed suspension of automated billing-run for the window 02:00-04:00 UTC.

alex_sre: Backfill 50% complete. Found ~8% net delta after dedupe vs live counts. Expected final delta ~1-2% after remaining windows reconcile.
maria_billing: If final delta <=2% we consider non-customer impacting, will send informational note. If >2% we prepare crediting plan.

pagerduty: On-call escalation: jia_oncall acknowledged at 4890012350, no further PD escalations.

incident-bot: Update logged to INC-489001: pause overage notifications, started backfill, suppressed billing-run.

jia_oncall: Thanks team. I'll update the incident channel and hand this to morning rotation. Please keep thread updates concise. Postmortem owners: alex_sre (technical), maria_billing (billing impact).

alex_sre: Backfill completed. Final reconciled delta ~1.4%. Closing action: run quick reconciliation script and re-enable billing processes.
maria_billing: Reconciliation complete. Removed `billing_investigation` tags, re-enabled billing-notify. Drafted customer note: short summary + credits for any substantive overages; waiting on legal sign-off.
eric_prod: Legal sign-off received, CS message scheduled. Billing run proceeded with corrected counts. No customer-facing overages charged.

incident-bot: INC-489001 resolved. Final severity downgraded to INFO. Postmortem assigned. :white_check_mark:
